patch_description: Replace the placement decision based on a GPU's current KVPR with one based on the maximum KVPR after the model is actually assigned. This directly optimizes the stated objective at every greedy step. Models are ordered by their intrinsic pressure when placed on an otherwise empty GPU, which prioritizes models that are difficult due to either high request pressure or large memory size. A small relocation refinement then moves models away from bottleneck GPUs whenever doing so strictly reduces the global maximum KVPR while maintaining memory feasibility.
